non_goals: No production postcode rows or polygons, live MINTEL or interoperability responses, real civic addresses, CUENs, cadastral identifiers, address or census points, roads, administrative layers, parcels, people, property data, OSM features, credentials or production geometry are bundled.

No text pattern, lookup rendering, unidentified FeatureServer, catalog field, census point, administrative boundary, parcel, building, containment, proximity, cached response or model surface is promoted to current official reusable postal geometry, an exact address-building relation, occupant identity, delivery entitlement or universal coverage.

sources.provider: Ministerio de Telecomunicaciones y de la Sociedad de la Información
sources.production_scope: Use only under pinned current terms and interface behavior. Record service version, request digest, observed_at, response digest, ambiguity and retention policy. The site says its adjusted cartography is referential and unsuitable for precision projects.

sources.provider: Ecuador postal regulator / official legal publication
sources.production_scope: Pin the exact regulation version and effective dates. It defines province, planning district and postal-zone semantics but supplies no current reusable row or polygon release.

sources.provider: Agencia de Regulación y Control Postal
sources.production_scope: Resolution ARCP-DE-2020-26 declares the national postcode lists, locality list, thematic maps and vector postal-polygon file public. Article 3 requires interested natural or legal persons to accept the annexed use agreement and meet its conditions; Article 4 requires download safeguards. The fixed five-page resolution omits Annex 1. Obtain the current artifact and complete agreement, perform legal and technical review, and receive explicit authorization before acceptance or download.

sources.provider: Dirección Nacional de Registros Públicos / postal interoperability source
sources.production_scope: Require exact service contract, institutional authorization, lawful purpose, input minimisation, response fields, retention, rate limits and redistribution terms. A catalog entry is not callable anonymous access.

sources.provider: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos
sources.production_scope: Pin service item GUID, layer ID, update time, schema, CRS, query parameters, response digest and the applicable INEC cartographic-use policy. Do not retain personal census data or claim metric or jurisdictional precision.

Resolve every selected layer to exact scale, vintage, CRS, coverage, licence, access registration, service endpoint and digest. Some licences restrict commercial use, transfer and internet redistribution.

sources.provider: Sistema Nacional de Catastro / municipal and metropolitan GADs
sources.production_scope: Resolve an exact GAD dataset and pin producer, field dictionary, parcel and building identifiers, version, CRS, validity, licence, privacy classification and digest. Do not publish owner, resident, value, utility or tax fields without explicit authority.
ODbL provenance and partitioning required; no MINTEL, DINARP, INEC, IGM, GAD, occupant or automatic exact address-building authority.
